name: salt-read

graded_by.test: owed: U2's handler tests in core/ (against C7, over a fake vault); E4 phase 6 (U2: auth, locks and the vault and device HTTP handlers over a fake vault); the test is named in phase 16

description: GET /vault/salt: a principal with a vault gets initialized true and its user_salt, 16 bytes in padded base64, public (credential-protection §4.2); a principal whose vault is minted but not sealed gets initialized false and its salt; one with none gets initialized false and no salt. The read never creates a vault or a salt: a GET writes nothing (OPEN-1.3 (c)); minting is POST /vault/salt (C7/salt-mint). Here the run's login has a sealed vault and the peer has none.
